title: Gus and the Truck with the Spinning Brooms
synopsis: Gus is delighted by a street sweeper with turning brushes, while Rex mistakes the roadside-cleaning machine for an enormous toothbrush.
continuity_state: Before: A rainy night has left damp grit, leaves, and small gravel along Brook Road. The rain gauge has a recorded reading, and the town drain and farm road have not yet been serviced this season. After: An adult-operated town street sweeper cleans the curbed part of Brook Road near Red Door Garage and the Pine Park roadside pull-off, collecting leaves and grit in its hopper. Ms. Pam uses the four delivered orange cones temporarily and returns them to the garage shed. No drain basin has been cleaned yet.
